projects.title: e-Citoyen — Tunisian e-Government Platform
projects.description: Built the frontend of a digital government services platform with React and Next.js. Designed responsive, accessible interfaces, implemented real-time notifications with Socket.io, and designed a Redis-based scheduled task system for background processing.

projects.title: Wide — Real-Estate & Loan Estimation Platform
projects.description: Redesigned the Wide platform's UI for usability and visual consistency, converted mockups into reusable responsive React components with Tailwind CSS, and built a Django REST API for real-estate calculation and estimation features.

projects.title: Kamioun — Operational Dashboard & Order Microservice
projects.description: Designed and built an operational dashboard with React for tracking orders, inventory and KPIs, built a Node.js/Express microservice for order processing and product management, and set up a Jenkins CI/CD pipeline with Docker containers.

projects.title: Reactit — Dashboards & Component Library
projects.description: Built dashboards and a reusable component library with React, Material UI and Redux, mobile interfaces with React Native, and Node.js/Express backend services for users, categories, warranties and quotes.

featured.label: featured work
featured.title: Kamioun — B2B Retail Marketplace
featured.summary: B2B marketplace digitizing supply for Tunisian corner shops — from ordering through delivery and cash collection. Originally built on Magento, migrated to Medusa v2 / Mercur.
bullets: Contributed to the Magento → Medusa v2 migration: analyzed existing REST endpoints and order workflows, mapped them to Medusa equivalents, adapted the mobile app's API layer to the new backend.
Built backend features on Medusa v2 / Mercur: delivery agent management, loyalty program, per-supplier delivery dates, COD payment flows.
Built the order confirmation module and an ads management module in the OMS (drag-and-drop placement config, dynamic rendering in the retailer app).
Built the retailer mobile app (React Native / Expo): catalog, cart, checkout, order tracking, loyalty, Arabic/French localization — published on Google Play.
Built delivery and order-picking apps: proximity-optimized routes via Google Maps API, delivery statuses, COD collection, daily KPIs.

projects.name: Coding Moon – Turn-Based 3D Combat Game
projects.description: A 3D web game built with React and Vite, featuring a turn-based combat system, health management, coin collection and level progression. Winner of the Coding Moon Challenge 2025 – EPI.

projects.name: E-Learning Platform – Online Teaching Application
projects.description: An online teaching web platform built with Angular for managing and browsing educational content, with responsive interfaces using Bootstrap and Angular Material on a Laravel backend.

projects.name: Manorga – Solar Panel Estimator
projects.description: A React application that estimates rooftop solar panel installation capacity using Google Maps mapping and weather data.
